generation.explanation: At each peg, a ball randomly falls left or right. After 8 rows, its final bin equals the number of right turns, so the probability of landing in bin k is binomial: P(X=k)=C(8,k)p^k(1−p)^(8−k). Watch the blue histogram build up against the orange theoretical probabilities, then change the right-turn probability or release more balls.
